headline: Sheeb border crossing with Iran closed indefinitely
dek: Iraq closed the busy Sheeb crossing (Maysan governorate) to passengers, vehicles and commercial trucks until further notice to review security and install detection equipment to stop smuggling of prohibited materials; other Iran-border crossings to close gradually; Shalamcheh closed in September…
sources: Reuters (Al Arabiya English); corroborated by Arab News, Gulf Today, Shafaq News, Kurdistan 24
fault_line: Sovereignty vs American puppetry — comment sections rage: US-pressured betrayal of a 'brother' vs necessary anti-smuggling sovereignty; the pocketbook sub-fault: tomato/potato/onion price spikes

sections.what_happened: Iraq closed the busy Sheeb crossing (Maysan governorate) to passengers, vehicles and commercial trucks until further notice to review security and install detection equipment to stop smuggling of prohibited materials; other Iran-border crossings to close gradually; Shalamcheh closed in September after drones launched from Iraqi territory hit Saudi
sections.what_verified: Reuters-sourced border official + 2 crossing sources; multiple Iraqi outlets; PM Ali al-Zaidi directive (Shafaq: 'technical reasons' variant)
sections.what_disputed: Reason disputed: 'technical' vs 'security/smuggling'; K24 cites September drone-smuggling background. No official government statement yet
sections.why_matters: Iraq is sealing its border with Iran crossing by crossing — the pocketbook angle (food prices, pilgrims, traders) plus the geopolitical why: drones that hit Saudi were launched from Iraqi soil. Map card: Sheeb + Shalamcheh + smuggling routes
sections.context: Background: Iraq — Sheeb border crossing with Iran closed indefinitely
